svg.aria-label: One designer turn: the author writes, the designer agent either changes the type in place with set_typography or calls paint_cover; a paint runs a concept call that brainstorms N concepts by artistic license, the app appends framing and the textless rule, the Images API paints a textless plate, which becomes a new version; the type is drawn on screen and baked into the download by Pillow.
svg.text: ONE TURN · THE DESIGNER DECIDES · CODE BRAINSTORMS, FRAMES AND PAINTS
paint_cover(designer_notes) — only when the picture itself should change
the type drawn over the plate
+ title + author at the plate's size
the same rules as the screen
how far the concept may move from the book's own look — the author's request always wins
textless + framing > the author's request > the book's style block > genre codes > the model's own idea
A paint is one designer turn, one concept call and one image; a type change is one designer turn.
